audit.why: Assassin tempo lane: Ekko owns early and first item, Vlad has a level-6 window and wins 2+ items. Matches kits and 52.2% WR at 2320 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart reads Skill x6 + Vladimir; content and packet both read Ekko x4, Vladimir, Ekko, Vladimir.
audit.why: Content whys are kit-coherent (E dash + W stun early, Hemoplague window at 6, Rylai's/Hextech restores his edge, Vlad wins two items). Aligning full to that.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side->Ekko, phases[4].side->Vladimir (why already matches), phases[5].side->Ekko (why rewritten), phases[6] already Vladimir.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digits; two Do's/Don'ts bodies are pasted trade lines; missing interactions: Chronobreak heals (anti-heal timing) and Phase Dive's auto-reset wind-up as the burst tell.
audit.why: Chronobreak is 110s rank 1 / 50 at max, W 22s, Q/E 9s, Vlad pool 28s; his R heals a percentage of recent damage so Grievous Wounds matters; his combo opens with an auto-reset whose wind-up is the real cue.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: His Rylai's/Hextech spike restores the roam-and-burst edge — his tempo outruns your heal until your item lands.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Sanguine Pool has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ekko Chronobreak: 110s at rank 1, 50 at max — it erases your kill and bursts back; track the hologram and save final damage for after it. - His W stun is 22s, his E dash 9s. - Your 28s Sanguine Pool has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. The R, the moment it goes right.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: His Q Timewinder is 9s at rank 1 — heal its chip with Transfusion between throws and stand off the return path.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: Past river with pool down, his Phase Dive auto-reset closes instantly — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to back off.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield or Ring + pots. Riftmaker into Sorcerer's/Swifties, then Cosmic Drive and Rabadon's. Zhonya's-Protobelt lines exist into dive — no mana items, ever.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield or Ring + pots. Riftmaker into Sorcerer's/Swifties, then Cosmic Drive and Rabadon's. No mana items — and anti-heal blunts Chronobreak's big heal.
